name: AC Maintenance Schedule for Los Angeles Climate and Warranty Protection

mainEntity.name: What ongoing maintenance schedule should I follow in Los Angeles’s climate to protect my new AC installation and warranty?
mainEntity.text: What ongoing maintenance schedule should I follow in Los Angeles’s climate to protect my new AC installation and warranty?

acceptedAnswer.text: Los Angeles’s long cooling season and urban conditions make regular AC maintenance essential to protect both performance and warranty coverage. Start by checking and replacing or cleaning filters every 1–3 months, depending on dust, pets, and usage. Dirty filters strain the system and can shorten component life. Keep at least a couple of spare filters on hand. At least once a year, gently rinse the outdoor condenser coil with low‑pressure water to remove dust, leaves, and urban grime, and keep 2–3 feet of clear space around the unit by trimming plants. Make sure nothing blocks the top discharge on vertical‑fan models. Indoors, verify that supply and return vents are not blocked by furniture or rugs. Most manufacturers recommend professional tune‑ups every year or two, which typically include checking refrigerant levels, electrical connections, safety controls, condensate drains, and system performance. Save invoices and service reports, since some warranties require proof of regular maintenance. Scheduling tune‑ups before peak summer helps catch issues early, reduces breakdown risk during heat waves, and maintains efficiency over the life of your system.
acceptedAnswer.description: In Los Angeles’s climate, protect a new AC installation and warranty by changing or cleaning filters every 1–3 months, rinsing outdoor coils at least annually, trimming vegetation around the condenser, and scheduling professional tune‑ups every year or two, following the specific maintenance intervals required by your manufacturer.
